data.context: In the Discussion of *Computer implemented inventions: patent trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO* (2024), this passage reports findings on the effects of the 2014 Research Affiliates and Alice decisions. It describes changes in grant rates for CII applications, especially those likely to face adverse patentable-subject-matter assessment, and a difference-in-differences analysis of whether pre-2014 CII applicants later filed CII applications at IP Australia.
